items.title: H-E-B: Buy $100 Visa/MC/Amex Giftcard & Get $20 HEB Giftcard Free
items.why: H-E-B is giving a free $20 gift card with a clipped coupon when shoppers buy a $100 prepaid Visa gift card, with similar Amex and Mastercard offers.
